tool.name: collection_paths_echo
tool.description: writes the input paths each path accessor gives the tool
tool.command: #set $coll_metadata_files = [mf[1] for mfs in $input1.all_metadata_files for mf in mfs] #set $coll_serialized = $input1.serialize() #set $single_serialized = $single.serialize() #set $single_metadata_files = [mf[1] for mf in $single.all_metadata_files] echo 'ALL_PATHS:#for $p in $input1.all_paths# $p#end for#' > '$out' && echo 'FOR_LOOP:#for $e in $input1# $e#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'COLL_ALL_METADATA_FILES:#for $mf in $coll_metadata_files# $mf#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'COLL_SERIALIZE_SOURCE:#for $s in $coll_serialized# $s["source_path"]#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'COLL_SERIALIZE_METADATA:#for $s in $coll_serialized##for $m in $s["metadata_files"]# $m["source_path"]#end for##end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE: $single' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_ALL_METADATA_FILES:#for $mf in $single_metadata_files# $mf#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_SERIALIZE_SOURCE: $single_serialized["source_path"]' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_SERIALIZE_METADATA:#for $m in $single_serialized["metadata_files"]# $m["source_path"]#end for#' >> '$out' && ## Rendering a metadata file parameter makes Pulsar stage that file by itself, so this is optional: ## without it, only the accessors above can get the metadata files staged. #if $metadata_params echo 'COLL_FOR_METADATA_PARAM:#for $e in $input1# $e.metadata.bam_index#end for#' >> '$out' && echo 'SINGLE_METADATA_PARAM: $single.metadata.bam_index' >> '$out' && #end if printf 'JSON_PATHS_CONFIGFILE: ' >> '$out' && cat '$json_paths' >> '$out' && echo '' >> '$out' && echo "JOB_DIRECTORY: \$(pwd)" >> '$out' && ## Checksums of the files the job can read at the paths above; a missing file gets no line. for f in #for $e in $input1#'$e' #end for#'$single' #for $mf in $coll_metadata_files + $single_metadata_files#'$mf' #end for#; do md5sum "\$f" | sed 's/^/CHECKSUM: /' >> '$out'; done
